Colour key Trumps Wands Cups Swords Disks Reference Dates are approximate (±1 day). Chakras are a modern overlay, not Crowley — marked [overlay]. Read by elemental dignity, not reversal. Emperor/Star show Crowley's counterchange. Thoth Tarot correspondence flashcards · verified against the Book of Thoth + 777

GLOSSARY — QABALAH & THE TREE REFERENCE Qabalah — The Jewish mystical tradition Crowley adapts; its Tree of Life underlies every correspondence. Tree of Life — The core diagram: 10 Sephiroth joined by 22 paths; minors climb it, Trumps are its paths. Sephira (pl. Sephiroth) — One of the 10 emanations/stations on the Tree; the numbers 1–10 each are a Sephira. Emanation — The outflowing by which each Sephira proceeds from the one before it. Path — One of the 22 lines joining two Sephiroth; each bears one Trump and one Hebrew letter. Pillars — The Tree's three columns: Mercy (right), Severity (left), and the balancing Middle Pillar. Tetragrammaton (הוהי, YHVH) — The four-letter Name Yod-Heh-Vau-Heh; maps to Fire-Water-Air-Earth and Knight-Queen-Prince-Princess. World / plane — One of four planes the whole Tree repeats in; Crowley calls them the “four planes” (see The Four Worlds). Minutum Mundum — The “Lesser World” — the Golden Dawn colouring of the Tree; the Queen-scale colours the pips take. GLOSSARY — ASTROLOGY & TIME REFERENCE Zodiac — The 360° ring of twelve signs the Sun appears to travel in a year. Sign — A 30° twelfth of the zodiac (Aries…Pisces), each with an element and a mode. Element — Fire, Water, Air, or Earth (plus Spirit) — the qualities everything is classed under. Triplicity — The three signs sharing an element (e.g. Fire = Aries, Leo, Sagittarius) → one suit. Mode (cardinal/fixed/mutable) — A sign's manner: cardinal = initiating, fixed = stabilising, mutable = adapting. Decan — A 10° third of a sign; the 36 decans each carry one small card, ruled by a planet. Chaldean order — Saturn-Jupiter-Mars-Sun-Venus-Mercury-Moon — the sequence that assigns the decans. Cusp — The boundary where one sign becomes the next (≈ the transition dates shown). Ascendant / rising sign — The sign rising at birth; with the Sun-sign it fixes a court card for a person. Nativity — A birth chart; Crowley reads a court as a person by Sun or rising sign at nativity. Planet — One of the seven classical planets, Sun through Saturn, used as rulers. Ecliptic longitude — Position round the zodiac in degrees; 0° = start of Aries (top of the ring). GLOSSARY — TAROT & READING REFERENCE Trump / Major Arcana (Atu) — The 22 titled cards, Fool–Universe; each is a path and a Hebrew letter. Minor Arcana — The 56 suit cards: 40 pips + 16 courts. Pip / small card — A numbered suit card, Ace–10; each is a Sephira expressed in a suit. Court card — The sixteen “people” cards: Knight, Queen, Prince, Princess in each suit. Ace — The Root of its element — the seed of the suit, set above the numbered cards. Root — Crowley's name for the Aces: “the roots of the four elements,” pertaining to Kether. Significator — The court card chosen to stand for the querent in a reading. Querent — The person the reading is for — who asks the question. Elemental dignity — Judging a card by its neighbours: friendly elements strengthen it, contrary ones weaken it. Well-/ill-dignified — Strengthened (well-) or afflicted (ill-) by neighbours; Thoth uses this, not reversal. Reversal — Not used in Thoth — where other decks read a reversed card, Crowley reads elemental dignity. Counterchange — Crowley's swap of the Emperor's and Star's letters/paths (Tzaddi↔Heh); their signs stay. Quadrant — A quarter of the heavens; Princesses rule quadrants round the N. Pole, with no zodiac span. GLOSSARY — COLOUR, CHAKRA & SYMBOLS REFERENCE Colour scales (K/Q/P/Pr) — The four Golden Dawn colour scales, one per World; each card shows all four. Flecked / rayed — A base colour speckled (flecked) or streaked (rayed) with a second, in the Prince/Princess scales. Glyph — The shorthand symbol for a sign, planet, or element (e.g. ♈, ☿, △). Chakra — A body energy-centre from yoga; here a modern overlay on the Tree — not part of Crowley's system. Quintessence / Spirit (Akasha) — The fifth element: the all-pervading essence behind Fire, Water, Air, Earth. Lotus — The flower Crowley uses throughout for the life-force and the chakras.
